column1: SPEC — AP, Vendor Portal, Payments, 1099/I-9 & Credit Card Feeds
Vendor self-service | Approval | Payment from bank/cards | Tax forms | Full card + bank feed automation
1. VENDOR PORTAL
• Vendor registers / is invited → submits invoices (PDF/email/API) → attaches PO if required
• Auto-capture W-9; request I-9 when applicable; 1099 eligibility from MD - Vendors
• Status: Submitted → In Approval → Approved → Scheduled → Paid → Rejected
2. APPROVAL WORKFLOW
• Rules by amount, entity, department, vendor risk
• Multi-level approval; SoD enforced
• Three-way match (PO / Receipt / Invoice) where applicable; auto-approve low-risk
3. PAYMENT EXECUTION + AUTO MATCH / CLOSE AP
YES — paying a bill in the AP portal must clear AP and tie to the cash/journal movement. Two paths:
PATH A — Pay inside portal (preferred, fully automated):
1) User schedules/approves pay from entity Operating bank (1000) or card
2) System creates Payment record linked to bill_id(s) + payment_ref
3) GL posts immediately: Dr AP 2000 / Cr Cash 1000 (or Cr Card liability) — bill status → Paid (or Partial)
4) When bank/card feed txn arrives: auto-match to Payment by amount+date+account+ref (ACH id/check #); mark feed txn Reconciled; no second AP entry
5) If feed never matches (timing/fee): exception queue — match manually or adjust fees; AP already closed from step 3
PATH B — Paid outside portal (wire/ACH manual) then feed hits:
1) Bank/card txn imports uncategorized
2) Matcher suggests open bills (vendor name, amount, due date)
3) On confirm (or high-confidence auto-match rules): post Dr AP 2000 / Cr Cash 1000, link bill+txn, status → Paid, feed Reconciled
MATCH RULES (configurable): exact amount; ±1 day (or ±3); same bank_account_id; vendor name/fuzzy; payment_ref contains invoice #; confidence score; auto-match above threshold, else suggest
PARTIAL PAYMENTS: allow multiple payments per bill; remaining balance stays Open; aging uses balance
BATCH PAY: one bank debit may match many bills; split application lines required
FEES: bank fee as separate expense line; net match still closes AP at invoice amount
4. BANK FEEDS + CREDIT CARD FEEDS
• Real-time or daily import (banks + Visa/Amex/MC)
• AI + rules categorization; receipt OCR for cards
• Reconciliation: Matched (to Payment/Bill/JE) vs Exceptions only
• Never double-post AP: if Payment already closed bill, feed only reconciles cash leg
• Auto-request/store forms; 1099 YTD; block pay if 1099 vendor missing W-9 (policy)
6. GL & REPORTING
AP Aging (unpaid only) | Payment register | Bill↔Payment↔BankTxn links | Unreconciled feed items | Vendor spend
Cursor: payment_id on JE + bank_txn; idempotent pay; full drill bill→payment→txn→JE. Spec - GL JE Close BILL-PAY.
